name: How long does a typical bathroom renovation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom renovation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a bathroom renovation depends on its complexity. A basic cosmetic update, involving paint, new fixtures, and minor tile work, might be completed in 1-3 weeks. A more extensive remodel that includes changing the layout, relocating plumbing, or custom tile work usually takes 3-6 weeks. Larger, luxury renovations with custom cabinetry and complex installations could extend to 6-10 weeks or more. We aim to provide a realistic timeline upfront and minimize disruption during the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines range from 1-3 weeks for minor updates to 6-10+ weeks for extensive or luxury renovations, depending on complexity.
